newsitem.title: POLAND: KPW CLEARS POLISH MIESZKO FOR PUBLIC TRADE.
newsitem.headline: KPW CLEARS POLISH MIESZKO FOR PUBLIC TRADE.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) has cleared 1.5 million shares of initial public offering and 4.2 million existing shares in Polish confectioner Mieszko SA for public trade, KPW said in a statement on Thursday.

The company, whose full name is Zaklady Przemyslu Cukierniczego Mieszko SA plans to offer 1.45 million new shares in an open tranche in April 14-18 and 50,000 shares in an employee and management tranche in April 7-11.

The company, which seeks a parallel market listing had a net profit of 4.1 million zlotys on 46.7-million-zloty-sales in 1996 and expects to lift its net to 7.1 million and sales to 70 million zlotys.
The firm's main shareholders are Przedsiebiorstwo Wielobranzowe Expand, which has 37.3 percent of shares and an individual investor 35.4 percent of shares.
